data.desc: Founded in 1986, Mastech (NYSE American: MHH) helps organizations transform their unique enterprise knowledge into business advantage by unlocking the value embedded across their people, operations, data, and systems. Through our expertise in AI, data modernization, cloud and data platforms, and specialized technology talent, we enable enterprises to innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and achieve meaningful business outcomes. By combining trusted data foundations, AI-powered solutions, modern platforms, and expert talent, we help organizations accelerate transformation and thrive in a constantly evolving business environment. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Mastech serves more than 250 enterprise customers globally, delivering the data foundations, AI-powered solutions, and specialized talent needed to help modern, future-ready organizations Thrive on What's Next.
